notices.title: New Version Update
notices.body:
@tag patch
My liege, here is what's new in the latest version.
Update the app from the store to receive the changes below.

## Demon Card Adjustments
[nerf d_darkknight] Now gains +1/+1 only when another Demon ally takes damage, instead of any ally.
[buff d_vampire] Instead of +1/+1 if any ally is damaged, now gains +1/+1 for each damaged ally.
[change u_vampirelord] Stolen health now counts as damage. Max health stays the same, and effects that trigger when an ally takes damage, such as Blood Countess and Demon Empress, now activate.

## Machine Card Adjustments
[buff w_cannoneer] Slay effect now gives a card of the same faction in your deck +2/+2 instead of +1/+1.
- This follows the attack and health changes announced in the previous notice.

## Card Descriptions
- Skill descriptions that said "same faction" now show the actual faction name. (e.g. "a Machine card in your deck")

## Visual Improvements
- When Blood Countess triggers, a crimson glow and blood drops rise above the card.
- When Vampire Lord steals health, blood drops stream into it.
- Apprentice Witch's Opening throws a potion flask that shatters, and Battle Mage's Opening sends a magic ring to each target.
- When granting Frontline, a shield flies from the giving card to the receiving card.
- Cards with the Defense skill now show "Defense!" as the attack approaches, so you can see which effect triggers.
- When both cards strike back at each other, their damage is shown at the same time.
- In auto battle, it's easier to see which of the three cards was picked.
- Tapping the screen now gives a small sparkle.

## Convenience
- A sort button has been added to owned cards in the Deck tab. Each tap cycles through rarity high/low and level high/low.
- Japanese is now supported, and card voices follow your screen language.
- Large amounts are now shortened (e.g. 123.4M).
- Your gold is now shown at the top right of the Training screen.

## League
- Rankings now show Power instead of score and wins.
- Other lords' info windows no longer show last login, battle record, or join date.

We'll keep refining the battlefield for you. Thank you!

notices.title: New Cards — Iron Titan & Clockwork Doll
notices.body:
@tag new
My liege, two new cards have joined the Machine faction.

[card w_titan] It has a shield that takes two hits to break.

[card n_automaton] When it falls, it powers up another Machine card in your deck.

## How to Get Them
- Now appearing in summons starting today.

notices.title: Machine Card Balance Adjustments
notices.body:
@tag patch
My liege, we have adjusted the stats of two Machine cards.

## Changes
[change w_cannoneer atk 3>4 hp 3>2] Higher attack makes it easier to finish off enemies.
[change w_engineer atk 1>3 hp 4>1] Falls sooner, so it powers up Machine cards in your deck more often.

- The changes apply right away, no app update needed.

notices.title: November 9 Update — Stages
notices.body:
@tag patch
My Lord, here are the stage changes in the November 9 update.

## New stages
- Normal stages now open up to Chapter 50, with new titles and comics for Chapters 21-50.

## Hard stages
- Hard now has 5 stages per chapter (previously 4-15).
- Fully cleared chapters count all 5 as cleared; new stages give no first-clear rewards.
- Chapters in progress keep your cleared count from the first stage.
- Shards and enemy decks per stage have changed. Rewards already received stay.

## Card growth
- As announced, level-ups need more EXP, and star breakthroughs and skill upgrades need more shards.

notices.title: November 9 Update — Card Skill Adjustments
notices.body:
@tag patch
My Lord, here are the card skill adjustments in the November 9 update.

Skill upgrade counts and costs are unchanged; only the values at each upgrade tier have changed. Cards you have already upgraded use the new values right away. Values shown are for skill tier 6.

[buff n_treant skill 3>6] Root Armor: counter damage now rises by 1 every tier.
[buff a_archmage skill 3>6] Arcane Storm: opening damage now rises by 1 every tier.
[buff k_dwarfking skill 3>6] Golden Hammer: the deck-wide bonus now rises by 1 every tier.

- Fixed skill descriptions for Gnome Inventor, Miner Girl, Dwarf Cannoneer and Engineer Girl showing numbers different from their actual battle values. Battle results are unchanged.

Please update to the latest version. Thank you for playing.

notices.title: Boss Raid Open — Iron Titan
notices.body:
@tag content
My Lord, the Boss Raid is open. Enter from “Modes” next to Sortie in the lobby, until Nov 16 (Mon) 05:00.

## This Boss
[card w_titan] A Machine Legendary not yet in summons.
- Escorts: Machine · Weakness: Nature (double damage)

## Boss Raid
- The boss's remaining HP carries over between fights. Bring it down over several fights.
- Defeat it for kill gold and escort card shards, then a stronger boss appears in the next round. Every 3rd round also grants Gems.
- Three fights a day, auto or by hand.
- When the period ends, the Endless Tower opens.

notices.title: Steelbanner Has Launched
notices.body:
@tag info
My Lord, thank you for waiting. Today the castle gates are open.

Summon cards, build your deck, and face your foes across three lanes.
A card that has been played won't return that match, so choose your order wisely.

## Launch Gift
- 1,000 gems have been sent to your mailbox. (Claim within a month)
- Check in daily to receive 300 gems on day 7.

## A Request from Your Steward
- Please report any issues or bugs via "Contact Support" in the title settings.
- For payment inquiries, include the UID shown in your profile so we can help faster.

I will keep coming back with new cards and news.
